about_the_game:
Cappu Dungeon is a skill-building based 3D action roguelite game where you equip a variety of skills to wipe out hordes of enemies. Players can purchase skills and combine them to create their own powerful combat style. Activate your skills at the perfect moment to overwhelm enemies and clear stages, while conquering the ever-challenging dungeons to claim victory.

Key Features:

● Skill Core System: Skills obtained in the game are equipped into "Skill Cores." Each Skill Core can hold up to 5 skills and is assigned to a specific key. During battle, pressing the assigned key will activate the skills in the core in sequence. For example, pressing the Q key will activate the first skill to the last one equipped in that core.

● Skill Purchasing and Customization: After clearing each stage, players can purchase new skills from the shop or modify existing ones. The combat style completely changes depending on which skills are equipped, allowing players to create their own unique playstyle.

● Combat and Strategic Skill Management: Each skill has a unique attribute, which can apply various status effects. Players must develop strategies considering the attributes and effects of their skills to defeat enemies. Mastering skill synergies will give players the edge in combat.
